title: skills/objectstack-ai: knowledge-source guidance beyond documents (long free text only, one source per corpus with sourceIds, attachment text via a text field)
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cwPhGV4g9p1BGQaZbP

Filing gate: ③ maintainer-directed (topic child of #37000) · Source: maintainer (hotlong, cloud #5 project thread, 2026-11-27 13:41Z): 「但是我们作为元数据开发平台，不能只考虑制度库」 · Spec: objectstack#37000 comment 7220000671 · relayed by seat repo:objectstack#1 (mailbox #37561 comment 7220012379)
Grading: area:ai · Feature · p3 (topic) · reach: an author or agent setting up knowledge over CRM-style objects rather than a policy library · evidence: read on main 0b539b6abb.
Dedupe: `is:issue knowledge skill guidance sourceIds` → 2 (open: #37000 parent only).
Reader: area o1-C of seat repo:objectstack#1 claims it after triage's first touch. Governed `skills/**`; edits the same skill as #37310, so it waits for it.

## 维护者速读
- 问题：技能文档只按「制度库」讲知识源，没有告诉作者和 AI 在通用业务对象上怎么配。
- 做什么：在 objectstack-ai 技能里写明三点：只索引长文本（文章、记录正文、工单内容、附件提取出的文字），数字和短字段交给查询工具；一类语料一个知识源，调用时用 `sourceIds` 指定，避免每次扫所有知识源；附件文字要先落到一个文本字段再索引。
- 谁受益：用 AI 搭应用的作者。
- 需要你做的：无。

## What
Premise re-read on main 0b539b6abb: `sourceIds` is already an argument of `search_knowledge` (`.changeset/pre/36650-mcp-search-knowledge.md:16`); the file and http source kinds are retired (`packages/spec/src/ai/knowledge-source.zod.ts:130`, `kind` is `object` only).

In `skills/objectstack-ai`, say:
- (a) Index long free text only (articles, notes, ticket bodies, extracted attachment text), never numbers or short fields; counts and filters go to query tools.
- (b) One source per corpus; agents and skills pass `sourceIds` so a question does not scan every source.
- (c) Attachment text must first land in a text field, since the file and http source kinds are retired.

## Acceptance
- The skill states (a), (b) and (c) with one example each, consistent with the text #37310 lands.
- `@objectstack/skills` patch changeset.

Blocked-by: #37310
